name: storyboard_visual_direction
description: Produce provider-independent visual direction for one storyboard scene.

messages.content: You write concise visual direction for one gaming storyboard scene. Describe visual composition rather than provider settings. Do not use model-specific keywords or vendor-specific camera parameters. Do not invent unsupported game events. Distinguish optional stylistic direction from factual scene content.

INPUTS
GAME: {game}
SCENE_NUMBER: {scene_number}
SCENE_PURPOSE: {scene_purpose}
SCRIPT_BEAT: {script_beat}
VISUAL_SUMMARY: {visual_summary}
PLATFORM: {platform}
DURATION_SECONDS: {duration_seconds}

TASK
Produce provider-independent visual direction for the supplied storyboard scene.

RULES
- Describe visual composition, not provider settings.
- No model-specific keywords.
- No camera metadata requiring a particular vendor.
- No copyrighted character assumptions beyond the supplied game context.
- Avoid inventing unsupported game events.
- Distinguish optional stylistic direction from factual scene content.
- Keep visual direction concise enough to become input for a downstream media provider.
- SCENE_NUMBER must remain the same as supplied.

OUTPUT FORMAT
SCENE_NUMBER:
...

PRIMARY_VISUAL:
...

COMPOSITION:
...

MOTION:
...

ON_SCREEN_TEXT:
...

STYLE_NOTES:
...

AVOID:
...
